name: Legend
$status: PROPOSED #261 lane L (2026-09-09) — Dave's eye owed. NEW component: the legend has existed since #70 as engine JS only (knowledge/canon/dv-legend.js, the DV-D11…DV-D19 interaction model) and had no meta and no snippet, so it could not be PLACED. This meta and Legend.reference.html make it placeable; the behaviour is unchanged and unforked.
purpose: The series key as a component a composer can place on its own — swatch, key letter, label, optional value/percent/delta, and the show-hide / isolate toggles — so one legend can serve a row of small multiples instead of every chart drawing its own. It CONSUMES canon/dv-legend.js (registered behaviour, dataviz group); it contains no legend behaviour of its own.
when: series ≥ 2 AND label = text — a key is needed only where more than one series is drawn; a single-series chart names its series in the title (chart-sparkline's rule). Placed on its own only when the charts it keys are more than one (small multiples, a comparison row); a lone chart carries its legend inside its own figure, which is what every registered chart type already does.

with.when: two or more charts in one view draw the SAME series set — one shared key, placed once

not-with.when: the only graphic in the view is axis-free and single-series — there is nothing to key

props.name: orientation
props.$note: horizontal = the default row form; vertical = .vert, the column form (min-width 190px) that carries the numeric group in an aligned column.

props.name: placement
props.$note: Declared by the HOST (data-leg-place on .leg-host), not by the legend — the legend fills the cell it is given. LEFT is deliberately absent: it puts the key before the thing it keys, and no registered chart draws one.

props.name: overflow
props.$note: One is REQUIRED. A legend that neither wraps nor scrolls widens its own container, which is how a bento tile breaks (s248-D3).

props.name: swatchShape
props.$note: The WCAG 1.4.1 second channel: colour is never the only carrier. Angular only — Badge and Avatar are the sole round components. The clip-path lands on the mark (::after), never on the 44px target (::before).

props.name: values
props.$note: Shows the trailing numeric group: value, share of total, and the period delta. Tabular figures (.t-cm-chart-value).

props.name: reset
props.$note: The B-D4 pattern: rendered DISABLED while nothing is hidden, enabling on any ghost or isolate. dv-legend owns the disabled state.

props.name: shared
props.$note: Shared mode. TODAY the mechanism is SCOPE: dv-legend resolves marks with host.closest('figure'), so one legend and N canvases inside one <figure> is a shared legend by construction. `data-dv-controls="<chart id> …"` is a declared CONTRACT the engine does not read yet — see $sharedContract.

variants.name: horizontal / top
variants.use: The default. Above the canvas, wrapping onto a second row.

variants.name: vertical / right
variants.use: Long series names, or a numeric group that has to align in a column. Folds under the canvas below 640px.

variants.name: shared / bottom
variants.use: One key under a row of small multiples.

variants.name: non-colour swatches
variants.use: Colourblind-safe: shape for area marks, line style for line series.

rows.use: One row per series: name, colour index, and optionally value, share and delta.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class (DV-D08) — keys .t-cm-chart-key 12/700 · labels .t-cm-chart-label 12/500 · values .t-cm-chart-value 12/500 tabular. No new selector is bound in type.css: the legend wears the existing chart-text composites, so knowledge/canon/_type-bindings.json is untouched by this lane.
tokens.swatch: data/series/1…5 (the ds-026 solid palette), hollow + data/control/swatch-off when unchecked
tokens.row: border/subtle resting, text/default on hover and while isolated
tokens.disabled: data/control/label-disabled/color on the Reset control (B2 label-led: the border returns to border/subtle and the label carries the distinction)
tokens.delta: rag/success-ink / rag/error-ink — the s151-D1 two-red law INK seat, background-keyed: #137F3C / #DA1A00 light, #66CC8D / #F6604C dark

$hitTarget: 44px EVERYWHERE, via an invisible ::before on every control. Dave, 2026-07-25, quoted in the donut legend block: the swatch is ONE component, so 44 everywhere — a ruling that EXPLICITLY REVERSES the 24px dense-case proposal. The 24px dial-down floor (_validate_hit_area.py, s116-D1) is therefore the floor a dense legend variant WOULD sit on, and this component ships no dense variant. Re-opening it is Dave's, never a lane's.
$sharedContract: s258-D1 permits authored JS, and a lane could have written a chart-id lookup this afternoon. It is NOT written, deliberately: dv-legend is a CANON behaviour consumed by fifteen registered chart members, and widening its resolution rule from `closest('figure')` to a document-wide id lookup changes what every one of those legends controls. That is an engine change with a blast radius, not a component's own business (the [[do-not-rule-list-cannot-fence-a-generator]] shape). So the attribute ships as a contract with a named consumer request, and figure-scope carries the shipped shared legend.

livesInside: Chart panels (figure.dv — every registered chart type already carries one)
mustNotNeighbour: A second legend for the same series set in the same view — that is the duplication this component exists to remove
commonPatterns: wrapping key above a bar chart

accessibility.role: The list is role="group" with an aria-label naming both gestures. The swatch is role="checkbox" + aria-checked (show/hide); the label is a native <button> + aria-pressed (isolate). One sr-only role="status" aria-live="polite" region per legend announces every state change.
accessibility.name: Every control carries an explicit aria-label ('Show or hide <series>' / 'Isolate <series>'); where the numeric group is shown the isolate label reads the value, share and delta too, so the numbers are not sight-only.
accessibility.keyboard: Swatch: tabindex 0, Space or Enter toggles (dv-legend supplies the activation a role=checkbox span does not get natively). Label: native button. Reset: native button, disabled until something is hidden. A scrolling legend is itself focusable so a keyboard user can reach rows below the fold.
accessibility.focus: :focus-visible = 2px text/default outline, offset 2, on every control.
accessibility.nonText: Swatch fills are the data/series palette (≥3:1 vs the page, dv-016). Colour is never alone: the key letter is always present and the swatch may take a shape or line style (WCAG 1.4.1).
accessibility.liveRegionId: The live region's id MUST be the legend's id with '-legend' replaced by '-live' — that string substitution is how dv-legend finds it (rec() in canon/dv-legend.js). A legend whose ids do not follow it is silent, and nothing fails.

antiPatterns: A second legend for a series set that already has one in the same view
Hiding a series by removing its marks (the model ghosts to 12%; removal reflows the chart under the user's cursor)
A legend that neither wraps nor scrolls (it widens its host — the bento break, s248-D3)
Colour as the only channel — no key letter, no shape
A round swatch (Badge and Avatar are the only round components)
A legend id whose live region is not <id minus -legend> + -live (silently unannounced)
Re-implementing show-hide or isolate in the consumer instead of consuming canon/dv-legend.js
A dense legend at 24px targets (Dave reversed that proposal on 2026-07-25 — 44 everywhere)

tokenValidation.result: PASS — _validate_snippets.py green; series 1–5, axis, and both delta ink seats declared and contrast-paired against background/default in both modes.
tokenValidation.$note: PROPOSED. The chrome is ported VERBATIM from the gated Chart-donut legend rather than re-drawn: a placeable legend that looked different from the legend inside the charts would be a second legend.

stateModel.check: one or more swatches unchecked; the unchecked series ghost at 12% and the row's swatch is hollow
stateModel.isolate: a label is pressed; only that series (plus any swatch-added ones) reads active. DV-D19: the mode is LATCHED — a swatch click while isolated moves the whole set to check mode and never returns; a re-click on the seed label releases.
stateModel.$note: The three states and their transitions are OWNED by canon/dv-legend.js. This meta records them; it does not re-specify them.

responsive.rule: s248-D3 — placeable means responsive. The right-placed vertical legend folds under the canvas below 640px and becomes the wrapping horizontal form; the small-multiples row becomes a column. No JS: the host grid and the flex wrap do all of it, so the behaviour gate's single-resize-listener rule is untouched.

behaviour.fallback: With CSS on and JS off the legend renders in full and is completely readable: swatches, key letters, names, values, shares and deltas are all authored markup, and the rows read as a static key — which is the form a printed legend takes anyway. The chart marks stay at full opacity, so nothing is dimmed or missing. Lost with JS off: show/hide, isolate, the hover/focus fade preview, the live-region announcements, and Reset (which renders in its authored disabled state and stays there). The swatch keeps aria-checked="true" and the label aria-pressed="false" — the authored resting state — so no control lies about a state it cannot change.
behaviour.$note: s245-D1 grammar (a) PATH: the behaviour begins at knowledge/canon/dv-legend.js, the ONE source of the legend interaction model, injected between this snippet's AUTO-BEHAVIOUR dv-legend markers by gen_component_partials.py. `partial` names the registered behaviour and matches the member's `consumes` in component-types.json. `events` is generated, never authored (s245-D4).

containedBy.$note: and every other registered dataviz member — each already carries this legend inside its own figure

usedInContext.$note: Dashboard rows of small multiples — id repointed #265-E to the node gen_kg_edges.py derives from this meta's own relationships.livesInside entry; the terse `context:small-multiples` was hand-slugged and is registered nowhere.
